findings.qa_handling: waited for awaiting_acceptance through the normal POST/tasks entry; no manual verify call

limitations: Minimal backend loop only: no browser/UI, no full crash-recovery suite (LG-021/LG-022).
Only the openai-compat (DeepSeek) backend was exercised; Gemini/Vertex remain unverified.
The delivery Run was driven to awaiting_acceptance by the coordinator's own automatic verify call; the harness never invoked verify_and_prepare itself.
Task `checks:` authorization is frontmatter-only in this version; the harness writes it directly to the Store before the Run executes (no HTTP setter).
sandbox isolation was not escape-tested; only the SDK-reported status is recorded.
